title: Superscript Numbers After Entry Words

illustrates.quote: Regardless of print placement, place the superscript number after the entry word in braille. Follow print for spacing.

items.def: /lĭv/ v. intr. To be alive; exist
/līv/ adj. Having life; alive: live animals

print.notes: The '1' in 'live1' and '2' in 'live2' are superscripted (here already placed AFTER the entry word, matching what 21.8.6a asks braille to do — unlike Example 21-34, whose superscripts sit BEFORE the entry word in print).

uncertain: The gold glossary term field cannot carry a distinct superscript-number segment (F-199/F-200); the entry word 'live' with its trailing superscript number is left out of `term`/`def` altogether here since neither field alone can reproduce 'live;9#a' (entry word + grade-1-numeral superscript marker) — recorded as not representable, matching Example 21-34.

printCorrections.was: null (the entry word "live" and its superscript number were missing)

Having life; alive: live animals" - the entry word with its superscript number, then the pronunciation. Braille: live;9#a _/l@+iv_/ ;v4 ... The superscript is written with the Unicode superscript digit; the runner has no superscript-number-after-entry-word mechanism (F-199), so the example stays not-modelled/mismatch.
